result.title: Loop4D: Embodied World Modeling with 4D VAEs and Looped Diffusion Transformers
result.summary: Predicting the outcomes of robotic manipulation requires modeling both visual appearance and evolving 3D geometry. This poses two challenges: video compression can obscure fine-grained robot motion, while jointly predicting RGB and geometry demands sufficient generative capacity. We introduce Loop4D, a framework that addresses these challenges through motion-preserving 4D representations and recurrent generative refinement. Our 4D VAE encodes RGB and pointmap sequences into compact spatiotemporal latents while preserving motion details and geometric structure. Our RGB VAE combines geometry-guided supervision with predictive reconstruction to reduce compression-induced motion artifacts. Our geometry VAE uses lightweight adapters to adapt pretrained RGB representations while preserving their priors. Building on these representations, our Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer maintains separate appearance and geometry streams with shared Transformer weights and cross-modal connections. By reusing Transformer blocks across loops, we increase effective depth without replicating backbone parameters, enabling models with fewer parameters to improve joint RGB-geometry prediction through additional computation. Experiments demonstrate high-quality 4D generation and validate Loop4D in simulated robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Loop4D：用 4D VAE 将 RGB 与点图序列压成保持运动细节和几何结构的时空隐表示，再用双流、共享 Transformer 权重并跨循环复用模块的 looped diffusion transformer 联合预测外观与几何，并在仿真机器人操作任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不增加骨干参数、靠循环复用模块换取有效深度」的递归式隐状态精化，可能为 LVR 中 loop 生成路径与推理期计算分配提供线索，几何保持的隐编码也可供核查视觉细节保真；但对象是机器人视频与几何生成，非 VLM 推理，需较多核查。
